messages.subject: Notes: Redline renewal call, Wednesday 29 April
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Notes: Redline renewal call, Wednesday 29 April, 15:00-15:45, dial-in.

Attendees: Marta, Tomás, Priya, Dev, Lena (notes); Redline: Bruno Alvarez, plus their ops lead.

Discussed:
- Renewal terms from last week; Bruno confirmed commercial terms are agreed
- Bruno restated his condition: the driver app must work offline for the pilot, non-negotiable
- Dev presented the phased option: read-only offline mode (cached routes and manifests, no editing) in ~1.5 engineer-weeks; full offline stays on the v3.1 roadmap
- Bruno accepted the phased approach as long as read-only ships in v3 and he sees a demo build before the pilot starts

Agreed: read-only offline mode goes back into v3. Full offline (with edit queuing) remains planned for v3.1. Work starts next week, ahead of the rollout plan.

Actions:
- Jonas: unpark the offline branch, strip the queued-edit path, target ~1.5 weeks
- Dev: demo build to Bruno by 15 May
- Tomás: send Bruno the updated renewal papers reflecting the offline commitment
- Priya: fold the work into the launch plan
- Lena: circulate these notes

Danke,
Lena

Lena Fischer
Operations & Office Manager, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Notes: Redline renewal call, Wednesday 29 April
messages.body:

messages.subject: RE: Notes: Redline renewal call, Wednesday 29 April
messages.body: Confirmed by Marta: read-only offline goes back into v3, Jonas starts Monday. I'm reworking the launch plan around it today - the two weeks of Jonas-plus-Ravi come out of the P1 tail, so bug burn-down slips slightly but the rollout dates hold. Dev, demo build to Bruno by 15 May as in the notes. Tomás, get the renewal papers out to Bruno this week while he is in a good mood. Thanks!
